title: Automated Graphic Design
tagline: Logos, banners, and social assets, generated on brief.

meta.title: Automated Graphic Design | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Logos, banners, and social assets, generated on brief.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Custom visual content for every campaign is expensive to commission and slow to iterate on, especially at the pace marketing teams need.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: A GAN-based design model generates multiple on-brand asset variations quickly, from a description and existing brand guidelines.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Marketing teams get design options in minutes instead of waiting on a full creative cycle.
